fusions.name: Swallowed Whole
fusions.desc: Closes your jaws over a weakened enemy, which deals 22 damage, leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Ribbed Hold
fusions.desc: Closes around every enemy within 3 tiles, which deals 12 damage and leaves them [Pinned] for 4 seconds. Your afflictions on each one spread to every enemy within 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Bubble Net
fusions.desc: Blows a curtain of bubbles 6 tiles long for 5 seconds that drags nearby enemies toward it and slows those it catches by 20% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Corral
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition, your next spell deals 20% more damage. Once every 8 seconds.
